components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action the merchant should take next.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 40px; background: #f3c76a; color: #000; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffe3a0, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffe3a0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-priority action that stays quiet on dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.095); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 40px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); color: #f7f3ea; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #18140d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffe3a0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Liquid Glass Toggle
components.description: A compact two-option toggle for language and market selection.
components.css: .ds-glass-toggle { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.2), rgba(255,255,255,.045)), rgba(255,255,255,.045); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.24), inset 0 -10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.16), 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.22); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(170%); } .ds-glass-thumb { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc((100% - 8px) / 2); border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.88), rgba(243,199,106,.82) 56%, rgba(255,255,255,.68)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.98), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.34); } .ds-glass-toggle button { position: relative; z-index: 2; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; min-width: 58px; background: transparent; color: rgba(247,243,234,.68); font-weight: 850; } .ds-glass-toggle button.is-active { color: #050505; }

components.name: Sales Queue Card
components.description: A compact customer item showing source, priority, and next action.
components.html: WhatsApp Quote LeadReply first · price / timing
components.css: .ds-queue-card { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.095); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); color: #f7f3ea; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-queue-card strong { color: #f7f3ea; font-size: 14px; } .ds-queue-card span { color: #aaa39a; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-queue-card:hover, .ds-queue-card.is-active { border-color: rgba(243,199,106,.58); background: rgba(243,199,106,.08); }

narrative.overview: NexaFlow should look like a serious, private sales operating system: dark, quiet, premium, and immediately useful. The visual job is to help a busy merchant understand the workflow without reading much.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-black base with restrained gold emphasis.
Practical queue previews instead of abstract AI decoration.
Compact controls and cards that work on mobile first.
Security and data protection shown calmly.
Bilingual English / Chinese support where adoption needs it.

rules.name: The Rare Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the decision color. Use it for the one thing the merchant should do next, not as decoration across every card.

rules.name: The Merchant-Speed Rule
rules.body: If a merchant cannot scan the first viewport in five seconds, the type hierarchy is too busy.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Useful Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat by default. Add stronger depth only when the element is a primary preview, modal-like panel, or floating action.

dos: Do lead with the workflow: source, request, missing details, stuck point, next reply, reminder.
Do keep the homepage broad for merchants and sales teams.
Do keep gold rare and directional.
Do preserve bilingual English / Chinese support on adoption-critical pages.
donts: Don't make the public homepage only for used car dealers.
Don't make one-click reply the whole value proposition.
Don't use generic AI SaaS purple-blue gradients, decorative card walls, or abstract AI blobs.
Don't build a complex enterprise CRM first impression.
